picks.name: L'Eclair
picks.source_note: Already in your library (seeded from Rekordbox as "Leclair"). New release from the Geneva instrumental duo.
picks.bio: "Echo" (November 6, 2026, Innovative Leisure) is a five-track EP from Geneva brothers Stef and Yavor Lilov's band L'Eclair, following their 2025 album "Cloud Drifter" and introducing a studio lineup expanded with bass, synth, and percussion.
picks.why_listen: Sleek, instrumental jazz-fusion blending drum'n'bass, footwork, dub and funk -- good for a groove-driven, genre-crossing moment in a set.

picks.name: dBridge
picks.source_note: fabric Originals already seeded -- this is on FABRICLIVE, fabric's companion imprint. dBridge's debut original EP for the label, following his 2010 FabricLive.50 mix with Instra:mental.
picks.bio: "Curiosity Clicks" (November 19, 2026, FABRICLIVE) is a four-track EP from Darren White, aka dBridge -- a drum & bass pioneer, Bad Company founding member, and head of Exit Records, best known for co-founding the atmospheric "autonomic" sound with Instra:mental.
picks.why_listen: Moody, atmospheric drum & bass from one of the genre's defining producers -- a strong pick for a deeper, more cerebral d&b stretch of a set.
